Reconcile

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 8, 2026

At Reconcile (available at https://rexe478-dotcom.github.io/reconcile/), we believe in financial clarity, radical privacy, and strict user control. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and web application.

1. Information We Collect

  • Account Information: When you register or sign in via Google OAuth, we receive your email address and basic profile identifier.
  • Subscription & Renewal Records: Details you manually enter or import, including provider names, plan types, renewal dates, prices, and reminder preferences.
  • Google User Data (Optional): If you choose to connect your Google account for receipt scanning, our app requests read-only access (gmail.readonly) solely to scan for subscription receipts and renewal notices.
Google API Limited Use Disclosure

Reconcile's use and transfer to any other app of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We never share, sell, or use your Google data for advertising, machine learning model training, or unauthorized third-party transfers.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To track your upcoming recurring subscriptions and renewals.
  • To send timely browser push reminders before your cards are charged.
  • To synchronize your subscription ledger across your authenticated devices securely.
  • To parse renewal invoices and dates directly in your browser.

3. Data Storage & Security

Your subscription data is encrypted and stored securely using cloud database infrastructure (PostgreSQL). We apply industry-standard transport layer security (HTTPS/TLS) for all data in transit. We do not store your Google account password.

4. Data Deletion & Your Rights

You own your data. You may export your complete subscription ledger as a CSV or Calendar (.ICS) file at any time from Settings. You can also delete your account and associated records immediately upon request.

5. Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or your personal data, please contact us at:

Email: support@reconcile.app
